lines.text: What if every woman and girl on Earth vanished, in a single instant?
More than four billion people. Half of humanity, gone.

segments.caption: Hospitals in crisis
segments.fact: 85% OF THE WORLD'S NURSES ARE WOMEN

lines.text: Minute one. In hospitals, more than eight out of ten nurses disappear mid-shift.
Patients are left waiting, and the doctors who remain can't cover every bed.
Hour one. Two thirds of primary school teachers are gone, and in pre-school, almost all of them.
Half the desks sit empty too.

segments.caption: The unseen work
segments.fact: WOMEN DO ~76% OF UNPAID CARE WORK

lines.text: Day one. At home, the gap is even bigger.
Women do about three quarters of the world's unpaid care work: cooking, cleaning, and caring for children and elders.
Week one. Offices, farms and governments are suddenly half empty. Cities slow to a crawl, and millions of families grieve.
Year one. The biggest change is silent. No more babies are born, and the maternity ward stays empty.
Within about a century, the last people grow old, and nature slowly takes back the cities.
It would show just how much of the world women hold together.
So, who would you miss the most?
